name: weaver-next
description: A local-first semantic canvas for branching ideas and reviewing every coding-agent change.

interface.shortDescription: Branch ideas with Codex on a shared, reviewable semantic canvas.
interface.longDescription: Weaver gives you and Codex a shared semantic canvas for research, learning, planning, and complex thought. Preserve branches and typed relationships, project one local-first graph into maps, flows, timelines, boards, matrices, and tables, and preview every agent-proposed content or layout change before it is applied.
defaultPrompt: Open the Weaver space for this project.
Create a mind-map space from a visual template.
Show the current content as a timeline without changing the graph.
